action.objective: Verify Bxf6 (g5f6) as the reserved candidate at full depth 4 to confirm or refute the broad-search suggestion.
action.rationale: Broad search at depth 2 suggested g5f6 (145, exact) as best; f6 knight is the piece that just retreated from h5. Bxf6 wins the knight for a bishop after exf6, and e5-knight is not hanging since exf6 recaptures. Depth 2 is shallow, so I will verify the reserved move at max depth before committing. Bxf6 also prevents the Black knight from harassing and gives Black doubled f-pawns after exf6.
